remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No sig [notes inscription 2]. Compared photo. with ptg." Backing board separated from work and owned by The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation {Now at the Georgia O'Keeffe Museum). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Two tan-colored walls of Ranchos Church meet to form a corner, one illuminated and one in shadow. A low wall extends out from the shaded side. Just beyond, a bright blue sky dotted with clouds is visible.
